note: Generated from code by scripts/generate-owner-system-map.mjs. Storage is JSON per club; relationships marked "inferred" are naming conventions, not database constraints.

storage.name: tenants/<club>/db.json
storage.description: All club records (swimmers, squads, sessions, sets, results, tests, competitions, invitations ...). Written through serialised atomic writes with snapshots.

storage.name: auth-users.json
storage.description: Login accounts: role, club (tenantId), password hash, billing state, athlete club connections. Never sent to browsers.

storage.name: CPD store (Education)
storage.description: Course purchases, entitlements, progress, completions and certificates (cpd-module02.mjs).

storage.name: Athlete personal store
storage.description: Athlete-owned records (plans, days, tests, fixtures, diary, goals, profile, legacy) in the athlete's own space (athlete-personal-training.mjs).
